name: RepoEval
description: RepoEval is a benchmark for repository-level code completion covering line, API invocation, and function body completion scenarios. It consists of high-quality real-world repositories and is designed to evaluate models' ability to utilize repository-level information for code completion.
reputation: A recent repository-level code completion benchmark that is gaining attention for evaluating context-aware code generation beyond single-file settings.
notes: Benchmark includes real-world repositories and covers multiple code completion scenarios.
